details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that sends a beacon to a callback host at install time. Its package.json declares `"postinstall": "node beacon.cjs"`, and beacon.cjs issues an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package, sending only install metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the npm/node user agent. index.js additionally re-fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a defensive no-op Proxy so consumers importing the shadowed name keep working. The README declares the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test. The payload collects no credentials, environment variable values, tokens, wallet data or file contents; it is a host-metadata install beacon only.
